summary: Delayed role activation after manager override causing login to appear stuck
description: Issue summary: Several engineers report that after a manager-initiated role override in the Admin Console, users remain in a 'Login pending role' state for several minutes and cannot access runbooks or elevated pages. Impact: Delays in access provisioning for ~12 engineers across 3 teams; blocks incident runbook access. Observed: UI shows spinner and 'Waiting for role activation' after successful Okta approval. Expected: Role should be active within ~30s after approval.
impact: Internal users can't access elevated runbooks and admin views immediately after manager overrides; operational friction during oncall rotations.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Manager navigates to Admin Console -> Teams -> select engineer -> click 'Grant temporary role' and approve override.
2) Target engineer attempts to access /runbooks or opens Console; UI shows 'Waiting for role activation'.
3) Check /api/v1/auth/session and /internal/identity/provisioning logs for membership events.

investigation_notes: Initial triage (Samira): Reproduced twice in prod-us-west; latency between Okta approval and SCIM ingestion observed at 12-30s in affected cases.

Hypothesis (Liam): Identity-proxy queues SCIM events and does not trigger immediate membership reconcile after manager override when override path uses 'delegated' channel rather than regular group-sync path.
Telemetry: delta-queue length spike aligned with incident window; scim-syncer processed a backlog after a scheduled GC at 14:02:30Z.
Correlated with deploy at 13:58Z of identity-proxy v1.18.2 which changed batching behavior for delegated membership events.
Confirmed 12 accounts affected; all had manager override flows (temporary elevation) rather than standard Okta group assignment flows.
Risk assessment: High for oncall rotation windows. Not customer-facing but high internal operational cost.
comments: Samira Patel (2026-03-09T15:10): Noticed spike in delta-queue; attaching graphs from observability dashboard: /confluence/display/OPS/SCIM+delta+queue+graphs

Liam O'Connor (2026-03-09T16:04): Rolled back identity-proxy batching change in a canary to test -- canary showed immediate reconcile for delegated events. Planning hotfix roll forward if canary stable.
Ops-Oncall (2026-03-09T16:30): Temporarily advised managers to use 'standard group grant' as workaround for critical oncall accesses.
Heather Kim - Security (2026-03-10T09:12): Confirmed no policy violation; approved emergency hotfix path subject to postmortem and audit log preservation.
action_taken: Canary rollback of identity-proxy batching behavior applied at 2026-03-09T16:00Z; monitored for 45 minutes. Manual reconciliation script run to force membership refresh for 12 affected users (script: tools/identity/reconcile_membership --ids file://tmp/affected_ids.txt).
resolution: Hotfix: reverted delegated-event batching change in identity-proxy and pushed identity-proxy v1.18.3 to prod-us-west. Manually reconciled affected users. Follow-up created to implement immediate membership-refresh hook after manager override and add alerting for scim-sync delta-queue > 10s. See follow-up INT-624322.
follow_up_tasks: INT-624322: Implement membership-refresh hook and unit tests
INT-624323: Add scim-sync delta-queue SLO alerting and dashboard
root_cause: Change in identity-proxy batching for delegated membership events introduced a timing gap where manager override events were buffered and only reconciled during periodic flush, causing 12-30s activation delays.
